description: This file contains functions related to managing chat session labels and filtering chat sessions based on recency and current selection.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable label from a raw session key, handling common prefixes and formatting examples like 'telegram:g-agent-main-main' to 'Main'.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of chat sessions based on recency, main session key, and current session, prioritizing recent and main sessions.
